name: Bing Quiz
description: Play daily and weekly Bing Quiz trivia with all 8 quiz types from your toolbar. No content scripts, no page injection, just a popup.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https://bingquiz.org http://localhost:*; connect-src 'self' https://bingquiz.org http://localhost:*
